instr: Digits backward: watch a short list of digits, one at a time, then type them in reverse order, starting with the last one.
clue: Press Start and watch the digits appear one at a time. When they stop, type them BACKWARD, from the last digit to the first, with the keypad or your keyboard, then press OK. Example: if you see 3 8 1, type 1 8 3.
recall: Type the digits in reverse order: last digit first.
